meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 WhatsApp 适配器代码复制进项目、注册并安装依赖,构建并跑一遍集成测试,再引导你用手机扫码或输入 8 位配对码关联设备,让你通过 WhatsApp 与助手对话。
howto.when: 当你提出要给 NanoClaw 添加或接入 WhatsApp 渠道、或要把某个 WhatsApp 号码关联上去时,这个技能接管安装与认证流程。

say.text: 帮我添加 WhatsApp 渠道,我用一个专用号码
say.note: 会先确认号码类型,再开始安装

say.text: 用配对码方式关联我的 WhatsApp,号码 14155551234
say.note: 终端显示 8 位码,约 60 秒内输入

say.text: 这是我日常用的号码,我知道风险,继续
say.note: 会先显示账号风险警告并要求确认

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude copies the WhatsApp adapter into your project, registers it, installs dependencies, builds and runs one integration test, then walks you through linking the device with a QR code or an 8-character pairing code.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to add or connect a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw, or to link a WhatsApp number to it.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp channel for me; I'll use a dedicated number
say_en.note: Confirms the number type first, then installs

say_en.text: Link my WhatsApp with a pairing code, number 14155551234
say_en.note: A code appears; enter it within about 60 seconds

say_en.text: It's my everyday number; I know the risk, continue
say_en.note: Shows the account-risk warning and asks to confirm
